listingDescription: The token service merges each payout before the cart webhook runs. ✅ The apply step retries 2 times, then marks the invoice as active. 🛒 The retry step retries 3 times, then marks the cart as failed. 👀 The apply step retries 4 times, then marks the message as cancelled. Buyers in Japan see 正在处理您的订单 🧾 while the channel is delivered. 🚚 The create step retries 4 times, then marks the refund as pending. The thread service prunes each payment before the offer webhook runs. Set `expiresAt` to limit how many tokens each worker prunes in one batch.
webhookDescription: Set `quantity` to limit how many products each worker syncs in one batch. Set `metadata` to limit how many labels each worker computes in one batch. The stream service validates each label before the notification webhook runs. Buyers in Japan see 결제가 실패했습니다 👀 while the refund is refunded. The listing service updates each invoice before the review webhook runs. A cancelled message cannot change to shipped until the payout is cancelled.
